notes: «أنهما سألا عبد الله بن أبي أوفى» is rule 5: the two co-transmitters are the askers and Abdullah is the one asked, so he is the last link and his answer relays the Prophet's order
«قال الحكم ويديه» and «وقال سلمة ومرفقيه» are wording variants of the same saying with the same transmitters, left out
